title: Horten twin-jet flying wing, rear view showing jet engines (Fig. 2)
description: Photograph, printed sideways on the page, of a Horten flying wing aircraft seen from behind, showing its two jet engine exhausts set into the centre section and a damaged/weathered wing skin, standing on its landing gear. Captioned "Fig. 2" with a photo number at lower right. Part of a USAF report section comparing foreign tailless aircraft designs to reported "Flying Disks".
